entry.summary: Sentencing for importation, possession, and supply of methamphetamine; and participating in an organised criminal group. Importation of almost 200 kilograms of methamphetamine to New Zealand and other drug offending, all while the defendant was serving a sentence for like offending. Guilty plea and defendant's age overwhelmed by aggravating factors. Life imprisonment required in the circumstances of the case.
